title: Module 5: Structural Colors & Optics
description: How the Morpho butterfly manipulates light through nano-scale architecture rather than chemical pigments to create brilliant colors.

learning_objectives.statement: Distinguish pigmentary color from structural color and explain why one fades while the other does not
Describe the nano-scale lamellar architecture of the Morpho wing scale as a multilayer interference stack
Apply the thin-film and multilayer Bragg conditions to predict which wavelength a given layer spacing reflects
Calculate the layer thickness needed to produce a target color, and predict how the color shifts with viewing angle
Translate the optical function (durable, wavelength-selective reflection) into engineering applications such as displays, coatings, and anti-counterfeiting marks

alignment_method: deterministic lexical mapping v2 with direct-evidence fallback; instructor review required
